arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, assess the 21/63-session macro and monetary-policy transmission channels using seeded Fed/FRED sources and the fixed SPY/IWM/HYG context if usable: rates/discounting, growth/liquidity and credit-risk channels. Separate dated facts from conditional inferences; do not make an investment conclusion. State when current macro readings or policy-event timing cannot be established. Stop after the latest primary/normalized evidence identifies material channels.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether a shared rates, growth or risk-appetite regime materially conditions otherwise company-specific short-horizon theses.
